svg.title: Bender / built different
svg.desc: Bender from Futurama, waving with three fingers: silver barrel body, antenna, half-lidded yellow eyes, tooth grille, ribbed limbs and a chest door. The preview and downloadable 3D model share one procedural solid. A subtle hover and antenna pulse stop when reduced motion is preferred.

g.text: A little attitude. A lot of metal.
